packages.name: najm-core
notes: Hide internal details in production 5xx responses while preserving status and logging the original server error.
Require Hono ^4.13.12.

packages.name: najm-guard
notes: Require patched Hono ^4.13.12 and compatible Najm core dependencies.

packages.name: najm-validation
notes: Require patched Hono ^4.13.12 and compatible Najm core dependencies.

packages.name: najm-rate
notes: Breaking: omitted trustedProxyHops now defaults to zero and ignores forwarded headers. Declare the actual trusted hop count behind a reverse proxy.
Require Hono ^4.13.12 and the compatible core/guard releases.

packages.name: najm-cors
notes: Require patched Hono ^4.13.12 and compatible Najm core dependencies.

packages.name: najm-cookies
notes: Require patched Hono ^4.13.12 and compatible Najm core dependencies.

packages.name: najm-i18n
notes: Require patched Hono ^4.13.12 and compatible Najm core dependencies.

packages.name: najm-mcp
notes: Accept Auth 6 alongside the existing Auth 3/4/5 peer ranges.
Require Hono ^4.13.12.

packages.name: najm-storage
notes: Breaking: require Najm Kit 3 for the studio dependency; backend and storage APIs are unchanged.
Require Hono ^4.13.12 and Sharp ^0.35.5.

packages.name: najm-email
notes: Breaking: require Nodemailer ^10.0.14 and use its native transport/message types.
Verify SMTP envelope, message body, and attachments against a loopback transport fixture.

packages.name: najm-auth
notes: Breaking: adopt najm-rate 3 and najm-email 3; unconfigured rate limits use the socket peer and SMTP requires Nodemailer 10.
Require Hono ^4.13.12 and patched Next ^15.5.24 || ^16.3.6 for optional Next integrations.
Keep the existing Auth 5 revocation, recovery, and caller-owned database contracts.

packages.name: najm-api
notes: Breaking: aggregate Auth 6, Rate 3, Email 3, and Storage 4 with the production security fixes.
Configure trustedProxyHops explicitly behind a controlled reverse proxy; SMTP uses Nodemailer 10.

packages.name: najm-rag
notes: Breaking: adopt Najm Kit 3 and the compatible Storage 4 peer contract; accept Auth 6 alongside Auth 4/5.
Preserve the published 2.3.0 Darija query rewriter, its root exports, and najm-rag/query-rewrites subpath.
Require Hono ^4.13.12.

packages.name: najm-chatbot
notes: Breaking: update the optional RAG peer to Najm RAG 3; accept Auth 6 alongside Auth 4/5.
Preserve the current AI SDK tool inputSchema adapter and chatbot APIs.

packages.name: najm-whatsapp
notes: Breaking: adopt Auth 6, Rate 3, and Kit 3; omitted proxy trust uses the socket peer.
Isolate instance factories and Baileys loader mocks per test to prevent cross-file contamination.
Require Hono ^4.13.12.

packages.name: najm-cli
notes: Generate Next integrations pinned to Auth 6.0.0, Kit 3.0.0, Next 0.9.0, and Theme 0.3.0.
Use patched Next 16.3.8 in the production scaffold integration fixture.

packages.name: najm-kit
notes: Breaking for optional Next consumers: require patched Next ^15.5.24 || ^16.3.6 instead of older Next releases.
Preserve existing React UI exports and Tailwind/CSS contracts.

packages.name: najm-theme
notes: Require patched Next ^15.5.24 || ^16.3.6 for optional Next integration and Sharp ^0.35.5.
Verify managed theme builds with Najm Kit 3; existing theme APIs are unchanged.

packages.name: najm-next
notes: Require patched Next ^15.5.24 || ^16.3.6 and reject older versions during configuration.
Accept Auth 6, Kit 3, and Theme 0.3 while retaining supported prior Najm peer ranges.
